caveats.en: PreSonus says Snapdragon/Windows on Arm is currently not supported in Universal Control with PreSonus hardware, and will update when Arm drivers ship. No date given.
caveats.zh-TW: PreSonus 表示 Universal Control 搭配其硬體目前不支援 Snapdragon/Windows on Arm，等 Arm 驅動推出後會更新說明，沒有給日期。

evidence.title: PreSonus: Windows Arm (Snapdragon) not supported in Universal Control (May 2025)
